standouts.text: It closed back above its 50-day average: above it on 3 of the last 3 closes.

standouts.head: 1 of the desk's strategy kind buying
standouts.text: The desk's own strategies signaled a buy: 1 kind of strategy.
standouts.learn: The desk's own trading rules; when several kinds agree on a name, the read counts it.

standouts.head: Ahead of QQQ
standouts.text: Against QQQ it is +22% over three months.
standouts.learn: How the stock has done against its fund (QQQ for tech, chips and internet names, SPY for the rest); leaders lead.

against.head: Bounce in a downtrend
against.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
against.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

against.head: Resistance +1.6% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.6% above (0.5 ATR), where 4 levels (2 kinds) meet: the Feb 2 high, the open gap of Aug 5 and the Apr 17 low: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

against.head: Sellers control the volume
against.text: Over ten weeks, an up day traded 0.7x the volume of a down day.
against.learn: Volume on up days against volume on down days; above 1 means buyers trade more.

material.head: QQQ: below its 200-day
material.text: QQQ, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the December 2025 breakout level, the 50-week average and the October breakout level, where 7 levels (2 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the October high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Broke out of a 5-week base
material.text: On Nov 10 it closed above the base's top (17% deep), on 0.5x average volume, lighter than a strong breakout carries. The break session closed 0.1 ATR past the line on a 1-ATR range.
material.learn: A close above a ceiling that capped price before; strongest on heavy volume.

material.head: Selling is losing force (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a lower low in price (the week of Sep 28) against a higher low in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): regular bullish divergence.
material.learn: Lower price lows with rising momentum lows: sellers are tiring.
